user_query: I want to organize a company event to celebrate our recent success. Find me the product details of a trendy item on Tokopedia that I can use as a giveaway. Additionally, show me the featured treasury listings on Etsy to get some inspiration for the event theme.

TaskList.description: Query Tokopedia to search for trendy giveaway items based on popularity or recent trends.
Retrieve product details for the selected trendy item from Tokopedia.
Query Etsy to get featured treasury listings for event theme inspiration.
